identity.mission: Create a visceral, athletic, and premium dark-mode experience that feels like a Nike ad meeting a futuristic CRM.

scale.hero: text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-9xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-[0.85]

gradients.hero_text: bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-white to-slate-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent
gradients.card_surface: bg-gradient-to-br from-white/10 to-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10

grid_system.bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)] gap-4 md:gap-6
grid_system.hero_split: flex flex-col md:grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center

Header.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#1a1a2e]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10
Header.nav_links: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 hover:text-[#ccff00] transition-colors

Hero.headline: Massive, centered, uppercase. 'UNLEASH YOUR POTENTIAL'. Uses Barlow Condensed Black.
Hero.subheadline: Clean, readable DM Sans. Max width 60ch.
Hero.cta_primary: bg-[#ccff00] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:translate-y-[-2px] transition-transform shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)]
Hero.visuals: Abstract 3D volleyball court lines (SVG) perspective grid in background. Glowing orbs of Indigo/Purple.

BentoGrid.card_style: group relative overflow-hidden bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-8 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all duration-500
BentoGrid.card_content: z-10 relative flex flex-col justify-end h-full min-h-[240px]
BentoGrid.hover_effect: A 'spotlight' gradient that follows the mouse (if possible) or a simple glow scale effect.

StatsSection.style: flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-12 md:gap-24 border-y border-white/10 py-16 bg-white/5
StatsSection.label: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#ccff00]

GoogleSignIn.style: flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-white text-black font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors w-full md:w-auto

visual_enhancements.texture: Overlay a subtle noise texture (opacity 0.05) over the entire body to remove the 'digital plastic' feel.
visual_enhancements.shapes: Use CSS-only geometric shapes (circles, triangles) with blur-3xl to create atmospheric depth.
visual_enhancements.lines: Use 1px dashed lines (opacity 0.2) to simulate tactical volleyball plays or court markings.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE index.css: Add the new Google Fonts import for Barlow Condensed and Teko immediately.
2. FORCE DARK MODE: Ensure the 'dark' class is applied to the root or body by default.
3. NO PHOTOS: Do not use any stock photos. Use abstract geometry, gradients, and Lucide icons.
4. GOOGLE AUTH: Ensure the 'Sign in with Google' button is prominent in the CTA section and Hero.
5. CUSTOM COMPONENTS: Build the Bento Grid and Hero manually using Tailwind utility classes for maximum control.
6. USE SHADCN: Use Shadcn UI for standard interactive elements (if any complex ones arise), but style them to match the '#1a1a2e' theme.
7. FILE STRUCTURE: Create the landing page at '/app/frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.js' (or similar) and route it.
universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients on text unless it's a very large heading.
Do not use generic centered layouts for everything; mix alignment.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the dark background.
